name: bci2a_within
note: THE standard BCI IV 2a cell: session 1 trains, session 2 tests, per subject, 4-class, 288/288 trials. This is the protocol nearly every published 2a number uses, and it is the cell where this trunk was measured at 65.90 against EEGNet's 59.14 -- +6.8 -- in a predecessor harness. It has never been run in this harness. Two reasons it matters beyond convention: (a) reviewers expect 2a, and Cho2017 alone is a single-dataset result; (b) 4 classes give the encoder's extra capacity more label structure to use than the 2-class cell where it currently ties.
